title: Thomas Townsend Brown's UFO experience at 17
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Thomas Townsend Brown's UFO experience at 17, about early 20th century at Catalina Island, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he attributes a lot of his life's work to a UFO experience he had, I think, at the age of 17 on Catalina Island.
